l-m-m2-b01-01.title: Ngaba (a+b)² ihlala ilingana no-a²+b²?
l-m-m2-b01-01.goal: Hlola ukuba isibakala sokuba (a+b)² ihlala ilingana no-a²+b² siyinyaniso ngalo lonke ixesha, uze ufumane kwaye uchaze imeko apho singenyaniso khona (umzekelo ochasayo).
l-m-m2-b01-01.material: Isibakala: kumanani amabini nawaphi na a no-b, (a+b)² ilingana no-a²+b². Fumana i-a no-b ezibonisa ukuba esi sibakala sinephutha.
l-m-m2-b01-01.s.s1.r.a: (3+0)²=9 kwaye 3²+0²=9, ngoko ziyalingana. Ngumzekelo ohambelana nesibakala.
l-m-m2-b01-01.s.s1.r.b: (0+5)²=25 kwaye 0²+5²=25, ngoko ziyalingana. Ngumzekelo ohambelana nesibakala.
l-m-m2-b01-01.s.s1.r.d: Amaxabiso omabini angu-0, ngoko ayalingana. Ngumzekelo ohambelana nesibakala.
l-m-m2-b01-01.s.s1.explain: (2+3)²=25 kodwa 2²+3²=13. Ekubeni (a+b)²=a²+2ab+b², ziyahluka naxa nini na xa a×b ingeyo-0.
l-m-m2-b01-01.s.s2.model.0: (2+3)²=25 kodwa 2²+3²=13, ngoko amaxabiso amabini ahlukile. Ngoko a=2, b=3 ngumzekelo ochasayo kwisibakala.
l-m-m2-b01-01.s.s2.model.1: Ukuba a=2 kwaye b=3, icala lasekhohlo li-25 yaye icala lasekunene li-13, ngoko aliilingani. Oku kubonisa ukuba isibakala asilunganga.

l-m-m2-b0s5-01.goal: Hlola ukuba ibango lokuba isixa samabinzana amabini equadratiki sihlala sibinzana lequadratiki liyinyani rhoqo, uze ufumane uchaze imeko apho lingeyonyani (umzekelo ochasayo).
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.material: Ibango: Xa wongeza amabinzana amabini equadratiki, isixa sihlala sibinzana lequadratiki nalo. (Ibinzana lequadratiki lelo isidanga salo esiphezulu singu-2, umzekelo x²+3x.) Fumana ukongeza okubonisa ukuba eli bango alichanekanga.
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.s.s1.r.a: Isixa 3x²−x+1 sibinzana lequadratiki nalo. Ngumzekelo ohambelana nebango.
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.s.s1.r.b: Isixa 4x²−x+5 sibinzana lequadratiki nalo. Ngumzekelo ohambelana nebango.
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.s.s1.r.d: Isixa 2x²+2x+3 sibinzana lequadratiki nalo. Ngumzekelo ohambelana nebango.
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.s.s1.explain: (x²+4x)+(−x²+2)=4x+2. Amalungu e-x² ayacimana kwaye isiphumo sibinzana lomgca, ngoko isixa asibinzana lequadratiki.
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.s.s2.model.0: Ukongeza i-x² ne-−x² kunika u-0 kwaye ayanyamalala, ngoko isixa 4x+2 sibinzana lomgca. Oko kuyenza ibe ngumzekelo ochasayo.
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.s.s2.model.1: Kwi-(x²+4x)+(−x²+2), amalungu e-x² ayongeza afike ku-0, enika i-4x+2, ngoko asibinzana lequadratiki.
